state.evidence: One real accepted 125us CNS block; 359373 state coordinates,166700 neurons,25.58M edges. Full neutral 1ms capture matches 580 serialized arrays, RNG/events/output. The block has60global coefficient evaluations,10accepted trials,7internal event times =>8event-free intervals. Fastest possible scheme requiring>=one complete graph product per interval costs>=8products, ceiling7.5x before audits, failing prospective10x work gate. Local max relaxation rate*h=.09135, which alone does not bound coupled stiffness. Three actual oracle queries reproduced consumed target/rate/state exactly; off-trajectory robustness not universalproof. No candidate has run. ChatGPT preparing published MRI prototype. Minimum3 alternatives: A multirate analytic local split with recurrent forcing; B QSS2 source trajectories/CSC; C Jacobian Krylov, reserved no third fullprototype.
